value.rationale: The question is motivated by recently established sharp finite-order changes in repeated Minkowski averages, and resolves a canonical polytopal model in substantially greater detail: it classifies the complete set at every order, sharp anisotropic Hausdorff values in all lp metrics, its deep holes, the exact filling step, and the abrupt topological-dimensional jump from zero-volume strata to full convexity. These are intrinsic invariants of a natural nonconvex skeleton rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, and are not implied by the general bounds or distinct simplex constructions in the closest works.
